name: Wood logs (SoundAction 212)
description:
Wood logs. The recording is part of the SoundActions dataset: one sound-producing action recorded every day throughout 2022, inspired by the author's book *Sound Actions: Conceptualizing Musical Instruments* (MIT Press, 2022). Sound actions result from interactions between sounding objects, perceived as a holistic, multimodal "chunk".

Labels (three independent annotators, merged as in the TISMIR paper):
Perception type (Schaeffer): impulsive
Actions: dropping, mooving wood log, placing wood logs
Objects: branches, ground, hand, wood log, wood logs, woodens
Materials: wood, stone
Environment: outdoor
Enjoyable: yes

Recorded in 16-bit, 48 kHz with a Røde VideoMic Me-C on a Samsung S21 mobile phone. Audio is posted here in PCM quality. Video version: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DnuMNC-qWg0
Full dataset (audio, video, images) on OSF: https://osf.io/3z65b/
The dataset is described in: Guo, Tørresen & Jensenius (2026), Investigating Auditory-Visual Perception Using Multi-Modal Neural Networks with the SoundActions Dataset, TISMIR 9(1), https://doi.org/10.5334/tismir.223

name: Rock Dropped on Forest Ground 1_3
description:
Recorded and processed at 24bit 48kHz using the Tascam DR-40 Linear PCM Recorder.

Processing: Gain-staging and soft high and low frequency filtering. No EQ boost or cuts anywhere else. Also De-noised.
